settings.deviceFlowHint: Clicking opens your browser; sign in to GitHub and click Authorize — no registration, no ID to enter, no token to paste.
settings.enterCode: Enter this one-time code in the browser to authorize:
settings.accountsHint: Switch the active account from the top-bar dropdown; "All accounts" view aggregates tasks across accounts. Tokens are stored in plain text in local SQLite — a system keyring upgrade is planned.
settings.ghPathPlaceholder: Leave empty (display only since v0.3.15, no longer used)
settings.ghPathHint: Legacy field kept for compatibility; syncing now uses account tokens exclusively and no longer probes the gh CLI.
settings.orgHint: (stored in meta.org; editable directly in the database)
settings.boardModeDesc: Per-account board column mode: the board follows each account's mode when switching accounts; the top-bar switch is removed.
settings.customColumnsDesc: Add/edit a column: enter its display name and select the Project statuses it should match (multi-select). Closed tasks auto-move to "Done".
settings.customColumns.noStatus: No selectable Project status for this account yet; add custom match values below.
settings.customColumns.usedElsewhere: Already used by another column; duplicate is not allowed.
settings.customColumns.otherValue: Type a custom match value, then Enter or Add
settings.hooks.title: Agent Board Hooks
settings.hooks.desc: One-click install of board hooks plus /task-start|done|handoff commands: global goes to agent user dirs (all repos, auto-completed at startup), project goes to the target repo. Local files only, never touches GitHub; existing configs are merged, uninstall removes only TaskBoard parts.
settings.hooks.scopeHint: Global: writes ~/.claude and ~/.config/opencode; agents never installed are skipped; missing pieces are auto-completed at startup.
settings.hooks.manualHint: ° marks agents without verified one-click install: selecting them returns manual guidance.
settings.projectDiagHint: Sync auto-discovers all Projects under the account and reads their Status (no manual project name needed).
about.title: About TaskBoard
about.localData: Data stays in local SQLite and is never written back to GitHub
about.intro: Aggregates GitHub tasks assigned to / related to you into a local cross-platform desktop kanban every day; status flows automatically as AI agents work.
about.cap.kanban: Four-state kanban: todo / doing / processed / done
about.cap.sync: Scheduled / manual sync; GitHub-closed issues auto-move to Done
about.cap.session: Interrupted-session (session id) and handoff records, recoverable locally
about.dataTitle: Local data (never written back to GitHub)
about.mcpTitle: MCP setup (AI agents maintain the board)
about.mcpDesc: The app ships a built-in "taskboard mcp" subcommand (stdio JSON-RPC reading the same SQLite, zero Python deps). Add it to your agent's MCP config:
about.mcpFallback: Portable fallback (no app installed): use python3 + mcp_server/server.py; override the DB path with the TASKBOARD_DB env var.
